name: Farmers & Distillers

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: The restaurant asks guests to tell their server about allergies and states that scratch cooking prevents it from guaranteeing avoidance of cross-contact for life-threatening allergies.

summary: Founding Farmers & Distillers is confirmed at 600 Massachusetts Avenue NW. Eight current restaurant-issued breakfast, brunch, lunch/dinner, bakery, dessert, BBQ, family-meal, and special-menu PDFs fully enumerate the same 168 frozen products. No formal allergen matrix was found in four required searches; direct ingredient positives from the official menus are retained, undeclared allergens remain unavailable, and the restaurant's cross-contact warning is preserved.
